files.name: motion-prompt-127.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Ping-pong loop" (ピンポンループ), one of the names in "Motion graphics moves, part 2".
Motion Prompt #127

What it is: Plays forward, then backward, over and over
What the sample shows: A square travels to one end, then comes back along the same path as if played in reverse, again and again.
Spec:
- One round trip per 4.7 s: 2.35 s forward, then the same motion played backwards for 2.35 s (progress g goes 0→1→0, linear).
- A mint rounded square (48 px, radius 13) hops from x = 92 to 447 along three arches of height 62·|sin(3πg)|, turning one full turn with g.
- Four ghost copies, 0.045 s apart, opacity 0.1–0.4.
- A playback bar below: blue with a play label while going forward, coral with a reverse label while going back. The progress bar and its knob follow g.
- Vertical posts mark the two turning points.
When to use it: Use it for loaders, idle animations and any move that should repeat back and forth without a cut.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/127.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/motion2.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
